fallback.title: Voice
fallback.text: Dictation runs on the Mac that holds this plugin, and adds a Dictate button to the composer there. On iPhone, use the keyboard's own dictation key instead — it is the same idea, built into the OS.

body.title: Dictation lives in the composer
body.description: This plugin adds a Dictate button beside the chat composer on the Mac it is installed on. Press it, speak, and the words are typed into your draft — transcribed on that computer, with no audio leaving it. Open ADE there to see whether the speech model is downloaded and ready.
